info.name: Byruha API v1
info.description: Postman documentation for the Byruha mobile API. The collection is intended for the Flutter developer and covers every current v1 endpoint, request body, path/query parameters, and response examples. All endpoints are under /api/v1 and currently use no authentication middleware.

item.name: Customers
item.description: CRUD endpoints for customers. The API requires phone_number for create and update, even though email is optional.

query.description: Optional. Integer from 1 to 100. Defaults to 15.
Optional. Matches normalized Omani phone numbers.

request.description: Returns a paginated list of customers ordered by latest created. Optional filters: search matches phone_number or email; phone matches normalized Omani phone numbers; email matches email addresses.

request.description: Creates a customer. Required fields: name, phone_number, password, password_confirmation. Optional: email. Omani local phone numbers are normalized to +968 format.

response.name: 422 Validation error

request.description: Returns one customer by numeric ID.
Updates a customer. phone_number is required. name, email, and password are optional when using PATCH. Include password_confirmation when updating password.

request.description: Completes or updates the safe profile fields for a customer. Required: name, phone_number, civil_id, address, wilaya, area. Optional: email. Protected fields such as password, additional_info, status, role, balance, and affiliate data are prohibited.

response.name: 422 Validation error

request.description: Deletes a customer by numeric ID. Related family members and bookings cascade through database constraints.

item.name: Customer Family Members
item.description: CRUD endpoints for a customer's family members.

query.description: Optional. Integer from 1 to 100. Defaults to 15.

request.description: Returns paginated family members owned by the customer, ordered by oldest birth_date first.
Creates a family member for the customer. Required fields: name, birth_date. Optional fields: school_name, grade, medical_notes, relationship_to_customer.

response.name: 422 Validation error

request.description: Returns one family member owned by the customer.

response.name: 404 Not found or family member belongs to another customer

request.description: Updates a family member owned by the customer. All fields are optional for PATCH, but supplied name and birth_date cannot be empty.

response.name: 422 Validation error
404 Not found or family member belongs to another customer
